title: Onramp weekly sync — pocket notes
content:
Weekly pocket notes from SE+ProServices onramp sync — 2027-05-04
Owners: Ava (note taker), Diego (tech lead), Priya (project PM), Samir (SRE liaison)
Attendees: Ava, Diego, Priya, Samir, Jules, Katarina (customer success check-in)
Duration: 30m standup style; informal bullets, action-focused.

Objective: short digest for engineering handoff and escalations. Keep this lightweight — use as single-source quick read before pairing into ticket updates.

1) Veridian (enterprise fintech) — status: amber
- Current: Canary rollout of v2 model routing in dedicated cluster completed for 10% traffic. Latency baseline +8% vs expected on 4k token tails.
- Blocker: intermittent OOMs on quantized kernels for long-sequence requests. Repro steps in PROSERV-418. Appears correlated with concurrent KV cache warmup.
- Temp mitigation: reduce concurrency limit on canary pool to 6, enable aggressive prefix cache TTL. Diego to push pool config today (owner: Diego, due: 2027-05-05).
- Escalation: Samir to open SRE-side trace with infra team to capture GPU memory timeline during canary window (owner: Samir, due: 2027-05-06).
- Customer comms: Priya to send short update noting slower tails and mitigation; propose extended canary if mitigation stable (owner: Priya, due: 2027-05-05).

2) BlueCove (healthcare startup) — status: green -> watch
- Current: Private VPC deployment on staging completed. End-to-end tests passed for streaming and function-calling flows.
- Outstanding item: KMS integration for HSM-backed key rotation — docs mismatch between KMS plugin and customer KMS provider. 
- Action: Jules to produce a checklist of required KMS attributes and sample terraform snippet (owner: Jules, due: 2027-05-07).
- Note: QA flagged i/o spikes during burst tests; this is expected with their initial autoscale profile. Recommend tweak to burst window and queue depth. Diego to propose tuning values by next sync.

3) Tidewater (SaaS analytics) — status: yellow
- Current: Migration from hosted API to dedicated pool in progress. Data plane routing policy in config review; two regression prompts failed (summarization accuracy drift).
- Investigation: regression tied to model variant mismatch in rollout policy; reverted to previous model yesterday.
- Action: run prompt-set A/B eval on new quantized candidate; Priya to coordinate eval run with research infra (owner: Priya, due: 2027-05-09).
- Customer asks: ETA for stable build — provide conservative timeline of 2 weeks pending eval. Keep CSM looped.

4) Mosaic (pilot) — status: red (short term)
- Current: onboarding stalled due to missing network egress rules and audit requirements from customer's security team. They also request additional logging hooks for PCI-adjacent traces.
- Blocker: VPC peering & egress approvals delayed on customer side; need interim test harness with IP allowlist.
- Action: Ava to draft a minimal acceptance matrix and temporary IP allowlist template for Mosaic to accelerate testing (owner: Ava, due: 2027-05-06). Samir to scope additional logging hook as ticket SE-1297 (owner: Samir, due: 2027-05-08).

General ops notes / cross-cutting risks:
- Autoscaling noise: observed higher-than-expected scale churn on dedicated pools when prefix cache hit-rate drops below 22%. Ops hypothesis: cache eviction policy not tuned for multi-tenant workloads during bursts. Diego to validate metrics and propose tuning knob parity across pools (owner: Diego, due: 2027-05-11).
- Cost spike watch: two customers showed 40% token cost increase during heavy eval runs — recommend suggested burst limits included in onboarding docs. Priya to add a short paragraph to onboarding checklist (owner: Priya, due: 2027-05-07).
- Rollout policy clarity: customers keep requesting explicit fallback sequencing (region -> model-variant -> hosted API). Create a one-pager with example policy and failure scenarios. Jules to draft (owner: Jules, due: 2027-05-10).

Action items recap (sorted by due date):
- 2027-05-05: Diego — push reduced concurrency config to Veridian canary pool.
- 2027-05-05: Priya — send Veridian comms update.
- 2027-05-06: Samir — open SRE trace & draft Mosaic logging ticket.
- 2027-05-06: Ava — Mosaic IP allowlist + acceptance matrix draft.
- 2027-05-07: Jules — KMS checklist + onboarding paragraph for burst limit guidance.
- 2027-05-09: Priya — coordinate A/B eval for Tidewater.
- 2027-05-11: Diego — validate cache eviction metrics and tuning proposal.
- 2027-05-10: Jules — rollout policy one-pager draft.

Questions / parking lot items (not resolved in sync):
- Do we want a canonical SLO for tail latency per customer tier? (suggestion: define P50, P95, P99 targets for hosted vs dedicated)
- Should we include a quota for ephemeral eval runs to limit surprise cost spikes? Need engineering + finance input.
- Investigate an automated canary rollback trigger on OOM footprint delta. Could save manual rollback time.

Meeting cadence: weekly on Mondays 10:00 PT; next checkpoint 2027-05-10. If any blocker escalates to red, we do an interim warroom.

Quick links / refs: Confluence onramp-runbook-2027, Slack #se-proservices-onramp, Jira PROSERV-418 (Veridian OOM), SE-1297 (Mosaic logging).

Notes to self: keep these pocket notes terse; convert to ticket comments before EOD where relevant. Use this doc for quick sync with CSMs and SRE triage.

End of notes.
